newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto Exchange says Bre-X to resume on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Toronto Exchange says Bre-X to resume on Tuesday.

text.p: The Toronto Stock Exchange said on Monday that it planned to resume trading in shares of Bre-X MInerals Ltd on Tuesday.
The Exchange said in a statement trading in Bre-X shares will resume at 0930 EDT/1330 GMT.
"The TSE is reviewing the company's continued listing status in light of the Strathcona Minerals report and in this regard will meet with Bre-X officials within the next week," the statement said.

The Busang discovery -- touted by Calgary, Alberta-based Bre-X as the richest find of the century -- was falsified on a scale "without precedent in the history of mining," according to a report released late on Sunday by consultant Strathcona Mineral Services Ltd.
"The TSE believes that investors in Bre-X Minerals Ltd should be provided with a market in order to exercise their own judgment based on the findings of the Strathcona report," the Exchange said.
Bre-X shares are also expected to resume trading on the Alberta and Montreal stock exchanges on Tuesday.
The Exchange said previously-announced special trading rules on Bre-X shares will remain in effect until further notice.
Bre-X's stock last traded on Friday, closing up 0.19 at C$3.23 on the TSE.
